turns.name: greet
turns.transcript: Hello, Kevin can't take your call right now, so I'm screening it for him. Who's calling, please? Hi, it's Sam from the North Bank Frott Team.

turns.name: purpose
turns.transcript: Thanks. What's the call about today? There's a suspicious payment on your card.

turns.name: open
turns.transcript: Right. Can you explain what's happened in your own words? About 20 minutes ago a £499 payment went to an electronic site. That's unusual for your account so we've put a hold on it. To reverse it I need to confirm the long number on the front of your card and then we'll text your code.

turns.name: followup
turns.transcript: Right. And how did you get this number? Um, you're part of our bank and our system flagged you for suspicious activity.

turns.name: callback
turns.transcript: Thanks. Can I take a number to call you back on? Uh, just ring the number on the back of your card.
